items.name: 1 Body Cubing 2017
items.information: $15 base fee (includes 3x3) + $2 for each event after that. Registration fee is non-refundable. There will be an 80 competitor limit.

items.name: City of Joy Open 2017

venue.name: Sarada Prasad Institution, Ultadanga, Kolkata
venue.address: 108/18, Bidhan Nagar Road, Ultadanga Main Road, Kolkata - 700067

items.information: Your registration will be confirmed only after payment of registration fees. Visit [registration procedure tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CityofJoyOpen2017#1283-registration-procedure) for more information.

items.name: Classic City Shhhhh 2017
items.information: The registration fee is $15. There is a 40 person competitor limit. To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. EVERYONE MUST PAY, including Staff. Inproper completion of these steps may result in a delay of Registration. If you do not see your name on the compeitors tab after 48 hours of registering, please contact the organizers to resolve the issue. The event list consists of: 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 Fewest Moves, 3x3 with Feet, Rubik's Clock, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multiblind, Speed FMC(Unofficial), Pyraminx FMC (Unofficial), 6x6 Cube (Tentative), 7x7 Cube (Tentative).

items.name: Crawley Open 2017
items.information: You must pay the entry fee online via the button on the [UKCA site](http://www.ukca.org/competitions/upcoming-competitions/crawley-open-2017/registration) before your registration is approved. This fee is non-refundable, as it represents a commitment to attending the competition. There is a competitor limit of 150. Registration closes at midnight on Sunday 21st May.

venue.name: [Institut Premià de Mar](http://agora.xtec.cat/inspm/)
venue.address: Carrer de Rafael Casanova, s/n, 08330 Premià de Mar

items.information: Fees: €10 regular / €7.50 AECR members. Registrations will not be accepted until you complete the [payment](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IPMOpen2017#1280-payment). No registrations will be accepted the day of the competition. **Limited to 75 competitors.**

items.name: Meadowlands 2017
items.information: There is a 65 competitor limit to this competition. On-street parking only. Nearby bus stop on 190, shops, eateries. Train station 3/4 mile. Convenient to routes 3, 17, 21 which can be accessed by Parkway, Turnpike, and Route 80.

items.information: There is a $19 fee + $1 per event for this competition. There is a competitor limit of 120. Pizza will be sold during lunch and concessions. Visit the competition website for full details.
